title: Console UI: scaling policy configuration (min/max bounds, cooldowns, predictive toggle) for Dedicated deployments
creator: Chloe Martin
project: Autoscaling policies with customer bounds (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)
body:
Goal
Ship the Redwood Console UI for configuring per-deployment scaling policy for Dedicated deployments. This includes hard min/max bounds, cooldown/anti-oscillation fields, optional predictive mode enablement, and a “preview” that helps customers understand baseline capacity + max ceiling impact.

This ticket is Console/UI-focused (form, validation, guardrails, enablement gating). Schema/API work is tracked in ENG-22141; flagging in ENG-22148; audit events in ENG-22146.

User story
As a Dedicated admin, I can set min/max capacity bounds for my deployment so scaling never exceeds budget ceilings and never scales below baseline capacity needed to meet SLOs. Optionally, I can enable predictive mode so capacity ramps ahead of known traffic increases, while still respecting bounds.

Scope (must-have)
1) Scaling Policy settings section on Dedicated deployment page
- Location: Console → Dedicated → Deployment → Settings → “Scaling policy” (new card/section)
- Show current effective policy state and last updated timestamp
- Read-only state if user lacks permission

2) Form fields (v1)
- Enable scaling bounds (toggle):
  - Off: existing behavior (platform-driven) remains; bounds fields hidden and API payload omits bounds.
  - On: bounds fields visible and sent to API.
- Min replicas (integer)
- Max replicas (integer)
- Scale-up cooldown (seconds)
- Scale-down cooldown (seconds)
- Predictive scaling mode (toggle)
  - Only visible when bounds enabled (bounds required for predictive mode in v1)
  - Helptext: predictive biases desired capacity but reactive signals can override; final result always clamped to bounds.

3) Guardrails + validation UX
- Client-side validation (fast feedback):
  - min >= 1 (no scale-to-zero for Dedicated)
  - max >= 1
  - min <= max
  - cooldowns within allowed range (per API validation; reflect server error messages exactly)
- Server-side validation display (authoritative):
  - Render field-level errors returned by API (from PR-48315)
  - Render non-field errors (e.g., contract max exceeded, feature not enabled)
- Warning states (non-blocking):
  - “High min may be unmet during regional shortages” (links to runbook section + docs)
  - “Max is frequently hit in the last 24h” (if telemetry available; otherwise placeholder behind feature flag)
- Determinism/audit: UI copy must match ADR semantics (requested desired vs bounded desired; bounds are hard).

4) Preview of cost/capacity impact (v1 approximation)
- Display a simple preview panel before saving:
  - Baseline capacity: min replicas
  - Ceiling capacity: max replicas
  - “Estimated hourly cost range” (min→max) based on deployment’s instance type and current $/GPU-hour rate in that region
- Important: this is an estimate for planning; not a billing commitment.
- Data source:
  - Use existing Dedicated pricing metadata already displayed in deployment overview; if not available, show “Pricing data unavailable; preview hidden” (do not block save).

5) Per-deployment enablement + feature flag messaging
- If account/deployment not enabled for bounds feature:
  - Show read-only teaser with “Contact support / request enablement” CTA
  - Do not show editable form
- If bounds enabled but predictive feature flag not enabled:
  - Hide predictive toggle and show inline text “Predictive scaling is available for select customers (pilot).”

6) Change management UX
- Save requires confirmation modal:
  - Summarize changes (old → new)
  - Highlight that max is a hard ceiling; min is a hard floor
  - Warn that lowering max may increase queueing/latency during peaks
- Provide “Cancel” and “Save” actions; do not autosave.

Non-goals (explicit)
- Editing schedule/event calendars for predictive signals (out of scope)
- Multi-region placement controls (out of scope)
- Full cost modeling (token-based) in preview (out of scope for v1)

API integration notes
- Endpoint(s) from PR-48252:
  - GET current scaling policy for deployment
  - PUT/PATCH update scaling policy for deployment
- Payload behavior:
  - When bounds disabled, do not send min/max fields.
  - Predictive toggle should only be sent when bounds enabled.
- Error handling:
  - 403: show permissions message
  - 409: show “Policy changed since you last loaded; refresh” (optimistic concurrency, if supported)
  - 422: field-level validation errors

RBAC
- Only users with deployment admin rights can edit.
- View-only for others (including showing current configured values).

Analytics/telemetry (Console)
- Track events:
  - dedicated_scaling_policy_viewed
  - dedicated_scaling_policy_edit_started
  - dedicated_scaling_policy_save_succeeded
  - dedicated_scaling_policy_save_failed (include error class)
- Do not log numeric values in client analytics; only boolean flags (bounds_enabled, predictive_enabled) to avoid sensitive configuration leakage.

Acceptance criteria
- UI is discoverable from deployment settings and clearly labeled “Scaling policy”.
- Editing is gated by permissions and feature flags; unenabled accounts see a CTA, not broken controls.
- Validations behave as specified (min/max constraints, cooldown ranges, predictive requires bounds).
- Save confirmation modal appears and summarizes changes.
- Preview panel displays min/max capacity range and hourly cost estimate when pricing metadata is available; otherwise hides gracefully.
- Server-side validation errors render in-field and are actionable.
- Cross-browser: Chrome + Firefox latest.

Rollout plan
- Behind feature flag (per account/deployment) aligned with ENG-22148.
- Initial pilot: show only for selected Dedicated accounts; then expand to GA.

Open questions
- Should we allow predictive mode without bounds enabled? (Current proposal: no, for safety + clear semantics.)
- What is the exact cooldown allowed range surfaced by API? Need final from control plane validation (ENG-22141).
- Preview pricing: confirm where the region-specific GPU-hour rate is sourced in Console today; otherwise add a lightweight backend endpoint.

Implementation tasks
- [ ] Add “Scaling policy” card to Dedicated deployment settings page
- [ ] Implement flag checks (bounds feature, predictive feature)
- [ ] Implement form state + validation + save confirmation modal
- [ ] Integrate GET/PUT endpoints (PR-48252)
- [ ] Wire server validation errors (PR-48315)
- [ ] Add preview panel (baseline/ceiling + hourly cost estimate)
- [ ] Add client analytics events (see Analytics section)
- [ ] Add basic unit tests for validation and rendering states
- [ ] Add one E2E test: enable bounds, set min/max, save, reload shows values

Testing checklist
- Bounds disabled: no behavior change; no min/max in payload
- min>max: blocked with field error
- predictive enabled with bounds disabled: impossible via UI
- Feature not enabled: teaser + CTA; no edit controls
- Lacking permissions: read-only values; save button hidden

Notes from pilot feedback to incorporate
- Customers want clarity that max is a hard budget ceiling; use explicit wording “Hard maximum (never exceed)”.
- Customers asked for guidance on choosing min; include helptext and link to docs/runbook.
